# BridgeToAgent, inside your AI assistant

Your customers increasingly ask an AI assistant — not Google — whether a store is any good. So we put our readiness check where that question lands. Connect this to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and ask about any store. It’s the first AI-readiness checker an AI can run itself — fittingly, the product that makes you visible to AI is distributed by AI.

## Connector URL

Claude (Pro/Max) & Claude Desktop

Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → paste the URL above. Skip the advanced / OAuth fields — it’s no-auth.

ChatGPT

In a custom connector / MCP slot, add a new connector and paste the URL above.

Cursor

Use the Add to Cursor button above, or Settings → MCP → add a Streamable HTTP server with the URL above.

## What you can ask it

- check_ai_readiness Scores any store 0–100 and lists which agent-readiness files it ships (agents.json, llms.txt, agent-instructions.md, structured data). “Is allbirds.com ready for AI agents?”
